subject: Finova: request to activate phased mitigation playbook for Model12b latency surge
messages:
From: Alex Romero <alex@finova.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Finova SRE Team <sre@finova.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 08:12:00 -0800
Subject: Model12b p95 spike in prod — asking for mitigation playbook activation

Hi Sean / Marissa —

We’re seeing sustained p95 latency above our SLA (target 220ms) for the Model12b serving tier over the last 40 minutes. Dashboard attached (finova_slo_graph.png). Error rates are flat, CPU/GPU utilization looks normal but tail latency is climbing on requests with >1k tokens.

This is impacting customer-facing flows for our payments routing feature. Our SREs are requesting Redwood trigger the agreed mitigation: phased fallback that routes a percentage of traffic to Model12b-light (quantized variant) and temporarily enable the grace window until we stabilize.

Two asks from Finova:
- Can Redwood activate the phased mitigation playbook now (we need a quick decision)?
- We need a 3-hour grace window on the SLA for this incident; please confirm scope and monitoring expectations.

We’ve attached a snapshot of the SLO graphs and a short timeline of observed degradation. Please advise next steps and any risks we should be aware of.

Thanks,
Alex Romero
Director of Engineering — Finova Payments

Attachments: finova_slo_graph.png
From: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>
To: Alex Romero <alex@finova.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 08:30:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Model12b p95 spike in prod — asking for mitigation playbook activation

Alex —

Thanks for the alert and the graphs. We can activate the phased mitigation playbook from Redwood’s side. Quick summary of what we propose to do immediately:

1) Stage 1 (0–15 min): enable Model12b-light at 10% traffic with prefix cache warmup.
2) Stage 2 (15–45 min): ramp to 40% if p95 drops below 250ms for two consecutive 5-min windows.
3) Stage 3 (45+ min): if stable, hold and monitor; if instability continues, we’ll trigger full failover to the light variant and open a rollback window.

We’ll attach the playbook we’ll follow (phased_fallback_playbook_v1.pdf) and a short activation timeline. Dev, can you confirm the exact rollout commands and the monitoring hooks (alerts/SLIs) we’ll use so Finova is comfortable?

Regarding the SLA: we’ll need written consent to apply a temporary 3-hour grace window. If Finova confirms, we’ll annotate the incident and pause automatic billing penalties for that window. We’ll also provide continuous telemetry to the shared drive link.

I’m standing by to run the activation once I have two things: (1) written approval from Finova for the grace window, and (2) Dev’s go/no-go on the activation steps.

—Sean Gallagher
Head of Customer Reliability, Redwood Inference
From: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Alex Romero <alex@finova.com>, Finova SRE Team <sre@finova.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 09:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Model12b p95 spike in prod — asking for mitigation playbook activation

Folks —

I’ve reviewed the telemetry and the model runtime traces. Short answer: we can execute the phased fallback now. Operational details below (ETA measured from T0 when Sean instructs activation):

Steps (commands are internal shorthand):
- T0+0m: run redwood rollout start --model Model12b-light --route FinovaProd --percent 10 --warmup-prefix.
- T0+15m: evaluate p95 via /monitoring/api/finova/p95 (two 5-min windows). If p95 < 250ms for both windows, run redwood rollout update --percent 40.
- T0+45m: if stable (p95 < 250ms and error rate delta < 0.1%), hold; otherwise run redwood rollback --variant Model12b-original and notify.

Monitoring hooks: we’ll stream token-level latencies to the shared Drive (link above) and open a dedicated trace in the console. We’ll add an alert to #incidents and page Finova SRE on breaches.

Risks & mitigations:
- Slight degradation in generation quality expected for some corner prompts with Model12b-light (quantization artifacts). Recommend running a quick A/B on a 100-case promptset if you want quality verification.
- During warmup, you may see transient increases in small-sample tail latency; that should settle within 10–20 minutes.

If Sean gives the go-ahead and Finova signs the 3-hour grace window, I’ll execute T0 commands and post live updates in the thread and the shared Drive.

—Dev Patel
Staff Software Engineer, Serving Runtime
Redwood Inference

Attachment: activation_timeline.txt
From: Alex Romero <alex@finova.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Finova SRE Team <sre@finova.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 12:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Model12b p95 spike in prod — asking for mitigation playbook activation

Sean / Dev —

Finova approves the phased mitigation activation and provides written consent for a 3-hour SLA grace window starting at activation time. We require the following: continuous p95 telemetry to the shared Drive, immediate notification if model quality regressions exceed 2% on our quick-check set, and a rollback point if any customer-facing errors appear.

Please proceed with Stage 1 now. We’ll monitor from our side and will escalate if we see anomalous quality regressions. Thank you for the quick coordination.

—Alex Romero
Director of Engineering — Finova Payments
